accessNotes: The data-visualization pattern page and the data-vis colors foundation page were read in full (server-rendered HTML). Individual chart component pages (line chart, bar chart usage tabs) are client-rendered and could not be read; web_search summaries of them were judged unreliable and not used. Exact colours, fonts and sizes come from the official @cloudscape-design/design-tokens package (visual-refresh JSON) and the Highcharts style config in github.com/cloudscape-design/chart-components (src/internal/chart-styles.ts). Example images downloaded from the colours page.
summary: Cloudscape is AWS's product design system for consoles and dashboards. Charts live inside rounded white container cards with a bold container header as the chart title; the y-axis title sits horizontally above the axis in bold, the legend is bottom-left, gridlines are faint horizontal rules and bars have small rounded tops. Colour comes from a 50-value chevron-ordered categorical palette of five hues (blue, pink, teal, purple, orange) plus dedicated status/severity and threshold palettes, with full dark-mode equivalents.

colors.categoricalNotes: Generic categorical palette tokens color-charts-palette-categorical-1…50 (first 10 listed; the Highcharts implementation cycles the first 10). Five hues — blue, pink, teal, purple, orange — ordered by a rotating 'chevron' pattern so adjacent values contrast; always follow the order. 11–20 continue: #273ea5, #780d35, #03524a, #4a238b, #7e3103, #1b2b88, #ce567c, #003e38, #9469d6, #602400. Show at most 8 series for line/bar and 5 slices for pie/donut. Use one colour for a single series (don't colour each bar of one series differently). Status/severity palette (light): critical #7d2105, high #ba2e0f, medium #cc5f21, low #b2911c, positive #67a353, info #3184c2, neutral #8c8c94 — use only the values that fit.
colors.notes: No fixed sequential/diverging palette: 'build custom palettes' from 9 non-themeable scales of 10 values (300–1200) each; the sequential entry above is the color-charts-blue-1 scale (300→1200) given as an example of a scale. Guidance: darker = more important/larger; prefer multi-hue sequential over monochrome; never use adjacent steps of one scale together. Threshold line colours (light/dark): negative #db0000/#ff7a7a, positive #00802f/#2bb534, info #006ce0/#75cfff, neutral #656871/#a4a4ad. Grid, tick and axis lines all #dedee3 (dark #424650). Dark mode: container #161d26, body text #c6c6cd, categorical-1 becomes #486de8, -2 #e07f9d, -3 #018977, -4 #b088f5, -5 #c55305. All chart colours meet ≥3:1 contrast against the container background. Error-bar marker #131920 (dark #ffffff).

axisTitle.placement: y: horizontal, above the top of the y axis, left-aligned; x: below axis

typography.notes: Chart title is the Cloudscape Container header (heading-m 18px in visual refresh; heading-s 16px). Axis labels font-size-body-s 12px in secondary text colour; axis titles and plot text font-size-body-m 14px. All text in sentence case; no exclamation points, ampersands, 'e.g.', 'etc.'; dates per Cloudscape timestamp guidelines (e.g. 'April 6', '19:00'). Compact number abbreviations on axes ('250k').

structure.gridlines: Horizontal value gridlines only, solid 1px #dedee3 (very light).
structure.axisLine: x axis line drawn 1px #dedee3; y axis line not drawn (lineWidth 0).
structure.ticks: Small tick marks under the x axis (same #dedee3); none on y.
structure.zeroLine: No special emphasis beyond the x-axis line.
structure.yAxisTitle: horizontal, bold, above the y axis (e.g. 'Percent (%)', 'Total')
structure.unitPlacement: In the y-axis title in parentheses, e.g. 'Percent (%)'
structure.frame: Chart sits inside a Cloudscape Container card: white, rounded corners (border-radius-container 16px), thin grey border/shadow, header at top-left.
structure.background: transparent plot on the container background (#ffffff light / #161d26 dark)
structure.notes: Place charts only on the default container background in both modes.

legend.title: none in examples
legend.swatchShape: square for bars/pies; short rounded line segment for line series
legend.notes: Legend items are interactive (highlight/toggle series); inactive series drop to 0.3 opacity.

marks.bars: Columns with 4px corner radius (top), 2px border in the container background colour (gives white gaps between adjacent/stacked bars), group padding 0.075.
marks.lines: Thin (~2px) lines, markers hidden by default (shown on hover, radius 3 circle), straight segments.
marks.pies: Pie and donut allowed for ≤5 data points, snapshot data only. Pie size 60% of plot, donut inner size 80% (thin ring) with a bold summary value and secondary-text unit in the centre (e.g. '100' / 'total units'). 2px white separators between segments; connector lines in neutral #656871.
marks.notes: Use a 2px divider to separate segments on stacked bar, pie and donut charts. Error bars in neutral threshold grey. Threshold lines dashed.

labels.dataLabels: Pie/donut data labels 14px bold with neutral connector lines; cartesian charts generally unlabeled (values via tooltip/details popover).
labels.numberFormat: Abbreviated with lowercase k on axes (50k, 250k).
labels.dates: Follow Cloudscape timestamp guidelines; axis examples 'April 6', '19:00'/'19:30'.

furniture.title: Title is the container header text, bold, sentence case, describing the metric (e.g. 'CPU utilization', 'Configuration changes'); use titles, labels and legend to describe the chart's intention.
furniture.other: Optional chart filter controls and additional header actions; charts are dashboard items in configurable/static dashboards; consistent sizing for charts of equal importance.

annotations: Thresholds are drawn as dashed horizontal lines coloured by meaning: positive green #00802f, negative red #db0000, info blue #006ce0, neutral grey #656871; dimmed plot lines at 0.4 opacity.
layout: Charts fill their container; chart spacing [10,10,0,0]; vertical axis title block 24px with 4px margin. Use consistent sizes for charts of equal importance and minimise the number of charts per view.
interaction: Hover/keyboard focus shows a details popover (series details with markers); non-hovered series fade to 0.3 opacity; keyboard navigation with a 2px focus outline, 4px rounded; cursor line in tick colour; legend toggles series; optional filter dropdown. Full keyboard support and ARIA labels required.
accessibility: All chart colours meet minimum 3:1 contrast against the container background; don't rely on vision simulators alone; provide alternative formats (e.g. table) where possible; 2px segment dividers increase contrast between adjacent colours; keyboard navigation in logical order; ARIA labels.

discouraged: y axes not starting at 0 for bar/line where it exaggerates change
chartTypes.notes: Criteria table maps data type (numeric/categorical) and time period (continuous/snapshot) to chart type.

distinctiveRules.rule: Every chart sits in a rounded white Container card whose bold header (≈18px) is the chart title, left-aligned.
distinctiveRules.quote: Place charts only on the default container background color for both light and dark mode.

distinctiveRules.rule: y-axis title is horizontal, bold, placed above the y axis at top-left and carries the unit, e.g. 'Percent (%)'.
Legend is a single row at the bottom-left of the chart: square swatches for bars/pies, short line swatches for line series.
distinctiveRules.quote: Example images: legend 'S3 RDS EC2' under the plot, left-aligned

distinctiveRules.rule: Categorical colours follow a fixed chevron order over five hues: blue #688ae8, pink #c33d69, teal #2ea597, purple #8456ce, orange #e07941, then darker blue #3759ce, …
distinctiveRules.quote: It uses 5 hues (blue, pink, teal, purple, and orange), and has been ordered to be visually distinguishable … Follow the order of the palette

distinctiveRules.rule: Max 8 series for line or bar charts and max 5 data points for pie or donut charts.
distinctiveRules.quote: Consider displaying only up to 8 data series for a line chart or bar chart, and up to 5 data points for a pie chart or donut chart.

distinctiveRules.rule: A 2px divider in the background colour separates stacked-bar, pie and donut segments.
distinctiveRules.quote: Use a 2px divider to separate segments on stacked bar charts, pie charts, and donut charts

distinctiveRules.rule: Only faint horizontal gridlines (#dedee3, 1px); no y-axis line; x-axis line and small x tick marks in the same grey.
distinctiveRules.quote: gridLineColor: colorChartsLineTick … yAxisOptions lineWidth: 0; xAxisOptions lineWidth: 1

distinctiveRules.rule: Columns have 4px rounded corners and a 2px container-coloured border; group padding 0.075.
Donuts are thin rings (inner size 80%) with a bold total and a secondary-text label in the centre.
Status data uses the dedicated severity palette (critical #7d2105 → high #ba2e0f → medium #cc5f21 → low #b2911c; positive #67a353, info #3184c2, neutral #8c8c94) instead of the categorical palette.
distinctiveRules.quote: The color palette for data that represents status or severity, and made to complement the status-related components

distinctiveRules.rule: Threshold lines are dashed and coloured by meaning (positive green #00802f, negative red #db0000, info blue #006ce0, neutral grey #656871).
distinctiveRules.quote: Use the following colors for threshold lines based on what the threshold represents.

distinctiveRules.rule: Axis labels 12px secondary grey #424650; axis titles 14px bold #0f141a; Open Sans.
distinctiveRules.quote: axisLabelsCss { color: colorTextBodySecondary, fontSize: fontSizeBodyS }; axisTitleCss { fontSize: fontSizeBodyM, fontWeight: fontWeightHeadingS }

distinctiveRules.rule: Hover/focus dims inactive series to 30% opacity; line markers hidden until interaction.
Single-series bar charts use one colour for all bars; don't colour attributes of one series differently.
distinctiveRules.quote: for a bar chart that represents the total cost of a resource by month, do not use a different color for each month. Use one color instead.

referenceImages.describes: Two white rounded-corner cards with soft shadow. Left: 'Configuration changes' as a large bold black header top-left; below it bold horizontal y-axis title 'Total' above the axis; grouped column chart with three series (S3 blue #688ae8, RDS pink #c33d69, EC2 teal #2ea597), columns with small rounded tops and gaps between bars; faint grey horizontal gridlines at 0–250k (labels '50k', '250k' in grey Open Sans); grey x-axis line with small ticks; dates 'April 6'…'April 10'. Legend bottom-left with square swatches. Right: 'CPU utilization' header, 'Percent (%)' y title, five thin unmarked lines (blue, pink, teal, orange, purple) over 19:00–21:30, legend bottom-left with short line swatches. No source line or logo.

Two bordered cards (thin grey border, 16px-ish radius). 'Average CPU utilization' with bold 'Percent (%)' horizontal y title, a single blue line and a dashed green positive threshold line across the plot. 'New findings' mixed chart: blue columns with rounded tops, a magenta line overlay, and a dashed dark-grey neutral threshold at ~450. Very light horizontal gridlines, no y-axis line, x tick marks.

Two cards. 'Resource overview' pie with status colours (Running green, Failed red, In-progress blue, Pending grey) separated by white 2px dividers, starting at 12 o'clock clockwise. 'Findings severity' donut ring in severity colours (Critical dark brown-red, High red, Medium orange, Low mustard, Undefined grey) with white gaps and centre text '100' bold over 'total units' in grey. Legends bottom-left with square swatches; bold headers top-left.
